race.comment: PRE EMINENCE (1) sets the standard if he transfers his metropolitan Class 6 form to Emerald. He resumes from a two-month freshening, but his Doomben second to Zoubaby over 1110m reads well for this, and the return to 1000m suits a horse with three wins and two placings from seven runs at the distance. SAILOR'S RUM (9) is the clear danger after a sound fourth in a 3yo+ Class 6 at Mackay and a prior second as a well-supported favourite at Thangool; the 55kg impost and strong rider-horse record are genuine assets. OUTBACK ACTION (2) comes off a Bowen second beaten a nose and profiles as a reliable place chance with winning upside if he repeats that finish. MISSISSIPPI MORN (8) resumes after six months but brings a four-run winning streak and a perfect three-from-three record at the Emerald 1000m, so he must be respected despite the break.
